angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 3,334,429 km at 126.66 pc = 0.35 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.8954 +/- 0.0315 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92): 126.66 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 4.793 (4.695 to 4.890) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 3,334,429 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.949 (1.909 to 1.989) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5322 +/- 3.2 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 797597524475897600: teff_gspphot 5321.732 K (16th-84th percentiles 5318.455-5324.897), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 797597524475897600: teff_gspphot 5321.732 K (16th-84th percentiles 5318.455-5324.897), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/illyrian.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.367, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 82886 (pscomppars): spectral type G0, from Cannon & Pickering 1918 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1918AnHar..91....1C/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 82886 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.31 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 82886 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.14301, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 82886 (pscomppars): age 7 Gyr, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 82886 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.43 km/s, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
